title: Practice 8: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Гуси ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) буквой "V".
exercises.why: **летят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Geese fly in a V shape.

exercises.q: Самолёт ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) в Женеву?
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Does the plane go to Geneva?

exercises.q: За нами ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) вертолёт.
exercises.why: **летит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: There's a helicopter flying after us.

exercises.q: Лес рубят — щепки ___ (лететь — to fly, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **летят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: You have to break an egg to make an omelet.

exercises.q: Вы ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)? Еда остывает.
exercises.why: **идёте** — present tense (2nd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: Are you coming? The food's getting cold.

exercises.q: Привет, как ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) дела?
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: В сентябре ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) дожди.
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: Они ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) за покупками.
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
